Problem Statement:
Given an arraylist A of string type which has name#mark1#mark2#mark3 format. Retrieve the name of the student who has scored max marks(total of three).
input_spec: The input consists of an arraylist A of string type, where each string is in 'name#mark1#mark2#mark3' format. The size of A is at most 100000.
output_spec: The output is the name of the student who has scored the maximum total marks.
